notes.title: Storage Dealer Simulator 1.0 Release!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Storage Dealer Simulator 1.0 Update is Live!



In this update note, we're sharing the latest additions to the game and our development goals for the upcoming period.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681536/d880458af8943876d8bb06cc58c06b3075d96a03.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681536/56aaf76de8d487a44fcac8d1e0b4134410552d6d.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681536/5ea72c7d27eceeb041c9dc2c1bbcd46e230fe2b8.jpg"]
New Storage Area
A new storage zone has been added, located close to shops and various key locations on the map. These units mostly contain new items. Following this update, most new items will have a higher chance of appearing here.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681536/a88bd3b1785ee52039e5eac7a1f46630422b0702.jpg"]
30+ New Items
Over 30 new items have been added, which you can discover in the new storage area and throughout the game.

More items will be added with future updates.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681536/2ad6309dfddd3d4a57e8fa487c7bded7033b7f99.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681536/d9d941a453e90786634a3c1c64a1065c8b7fdca4.jpg"]

We've completed the Early Access phase; the core mechanics and gameplay are now well-established. We've also delivered one of the key goals from our roadmap. This is just one of many new features we're working on. Development will continue with new content and improvements. Thank you for your support!



\[Fixes and Content]

Auction system now saves correctly without issues.

A new storage area has been added to the map.

32 brand new items have been introduced to the game.

Fixed physics-related glitches when operating RC vehicles.

Improved performance in shop item placement logic.

Resolved issues where controlling RC vehicles caused bugs in the player's own car.

Customer system has been optimized to use less memory. 

A toggle for disabling Screen Space Reflections has been added to graphics settings.

notes.title: Storage Dealer Simulator 0.8 Update
notes.notes:
Hello dear players! 🎮

First of all, we’d like to announce that we’ve changed the name of our game from Dealer Simulator to Storage Dealer Simulator.

Don’t worry — development is still ongoing and the game is definitely not abandoned. More updates are on the way! We’ll be announcing the roadmap for the full release in the next update. We’ll continue progressing along that roadmap to make the game even better. 🚗🔧

We kindly ask players who experienced save issues to log in and check if the problem has been resolved, and to update their Steam reviews if everything is working fine. Thank you in advance for your support!

Note: Players who previously encountered save issues and haven't deleted the game or their save files will be able to continue from where they left off.

Storage Dealer Simulator 0.8 Update

[Fixes and Content]


 The issue where save files were getting corrupted or failing to load has been fixed.
 The auction system wasn’t saving; this issue has been fixed.
 New Steam Achievements have been added.


We're excited to introduce our new game: Car Dealership Simulator 2! 🎮

We need your support to continue improving this game. Your feedback and ideas are incredibly valuable to us. Check out Car Dealership Simulator 2 and support us today!

notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Dealer Simulator 0.4 Update

[Fixes and Content]

 The issue of trailers and vehicles being deleted when touching the trash bin has been fixed.
